# Artifact 11: Production Implementation & User Acceptance Test (UAT) Guide

**Generated By:** Agent_06_QA_Validation
**Domain Focus:** Verification / UAT Matrix

## 1. Transition Strategy & Phased Deployment Runbook

The transition from the current "Sandbox" architecture to a fully integrated Production environment requires a strict 3-Phase rollout to prevent catastrophic data loss during a live tournament.

*   **Phase 1: Shadow Mode (Alpha)**
    *   *Action:* Run the Tennis Suite in parallel with paper scorecards at a minor junior tournament.
    *   *Goal:* Test Wi-Fi resiliency on physical courts and validate the Umpire's Offline caching logic without risking the official tournament record.
*   **Phase 2: Single-Point Truth (Beta)**
    *   *Action:* Tennis Suite is the official scoring method, but Broadcaster APIs are disabled.
    *   *Goal:* Validate the Delegate's ability to handle edge cases (Walkovers, Disqualifications, Rain Delays) under pressure.
*   **Phase 3: Full Integration (V1.0)**
    *   *Action:* All Gate 1 and Gate 2 features are live. WebSockets push to Broadcasters and public fan portals.

## 2. Test Scenario Catalog (Critical Failure Modes)

| Scenario ID | Component | Description | Expected System Behavior |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **TS-01** | Umpire UI | Umpire rapid-fires 5 points while Wi-Fi is disconnected. | System caches 5 points in `IndexedDB`. No errors thrown. |
| **TS-02** | Middleware | An authenticated Umpire tries to `POST` to the `/api/delegate/killswitch` endpoint. | Middleware intercepts. Throws `403 FORBIDDEN`. No state change. |
| **TS-03** | Draw Engine | Delegate attempts to generate a Knockout Draw for 17 players. | System creates a Round of 32 bracket and assigns exactly 15 Byes. |
| **TS-04** | State Machine | Delegate attempts to change a player's seed *after* the tournament transitions to `LIVE`. | System rejects the mutation. Throws `ILLEGAL_STATE_TRANSITION`. |

## 3. User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Reference Matrix

To formally pass UAT, real human stakeholders must execute the following scripts in the Staging environment and sign off:

### 3.1 Umpire Role Script
*   [ ] **Test 1:** Log into assigned match. Score a complete game (e.g., 15-0, 30-0, 40-0, Game).
*   [ ] **Test 2:** Click the "Undo" button twice. Verify the score rolls back perfectly.
*   [ ] **Test 3:** Turn off device Wi-Fi. Score 3 points. Turn Wi-Fi back on. Verify the server reflects the 3 points within 5 seconds.

### 3.2 Marshall Role Script
*   [ ] **Test 1:** View the Court Dashboard. Identify an "Empty" court.
*   [ ] **Test 2:** Drag a "Pending" match from the queue onto the Empty court. Verify the court status changes to "Warmup".

### 3.3 Delegate Role Script
*   [ ] **Test 1:** Create a new Tournament Blueprint.
*   [ ] **Test 2:** Generate a Draw. Manually swap Seed 1 and Seed 2. Publish the Draw.
*   [ ] **Test 3:** Trigger the Global Kill-Switch. Verify the UI turns red and all matches halt.

### 3.4 Broadcaster Role Script
*   [ ] **Test 1:** Open the Presentation output screen on a secondary monitor.
*   [ ] **Test 2:** Select an active match. Watch the Umpire score a point on a separate device. Verify the on-screen graphic updates in <200ms.
*   [ ] **Test 3:** Inject a "Sponsor Logo" graphic from the control desk. Verify it appears on the output screen.
